name: dev-workflow
description: AI-assisted development workflow for Claude Code: bootstrap a new project from repo rules to an MVP roadmap, triage every task into lanes L0-L3, write spec/plan/ADR from templates, investigate bugs with a red test first, report change-request impact before editing, check FR -> task -> test traceability, and close sessions with gate, plan ticks and Jira sync. Per-repo settings live in .claude/dev-workflow.toml; a SessionStart hook suggests the skills only in repos that have that file, and a PreToolUse hook on the Skill tool shows the skill name whenever any skill is loaded. A `dw onedrive` CLI with the onedrive skill creates folders, uploads, lists and reads files in the project's configured OneDrive/SharePoint folders, either through Microsoft Graph (device-code sign-in) or through a folder synced to the machine by the OneDrive app (no sign-in or app registration).
